summary: Tier B (event-loop unblock) backend verification: 14/14 pytest cases passed in ~5.4s against preview. Verified: (1) bcrypt off-loop on register/login/me/wrong-password/reset; (2) googleapiclient run_in_executor wrapping on /api/search and /api/channels/{id}/sponsorship-data; (3) NEW 503 guard on /api/admin/saas-radar/enrich AND /ingest with matching running_job_id; (4) outreach status/follow-up-date/notes PATCH regression untouched and persisted; (5) /topic-counts + /products filter combo still sane. No regressions; login latency <1s, wrong-password <1s. No stuck SaaS Radar jobs left behind (cancel-stuck returned 0).

minor.issue: Review request referenced /api/channels/search but the actual endpoint is /api/search. Documentation/handoff drift only — code is correct. Test was adjusted to hit /api/search.

verified_scenarios.scenario: Register new user (bcrypt hash via run_in_executor)
verified_scenarios.details: POST /api/auth/register with unique email returned 200 + token; hashed via _hash_password helper. Elapsed ~0.7s.
POST /api/auth/login returned 200 + JWT in <1s. /api/auth/me with that token returned the lowercased email.
adrian@affilitube.com / admin123! returned 200 token; /me returned admin user.
Returned 401 in <1s (well under 5s). bcrypt verify off-loop confirmed.
POST /api/auth/request-password-reset returned 200/202; does not crash on the hash off-loop refactor.
POST /api/search with keywords=['productivity'], search_mode='channels_only', max_results_per_keyword=2 returned 200 in <60s. No 500/timeout.
With admin token and bogus channel id, endpoint returned 4xx (not 500).

First POST /api/admin/saas-radar/enrich {limit:1,use_llm:false,use_playwright:false} → 200 {status:'running', job_id:X}. Immediate repeat → 503 with detail.running_job_id == X. cancel-stuck cleared it.
First POST /api/admin/saas-radar/ingest {days_back:1, topics:[]} → 200 running. Immediate repeat → 503 with matching running_job_id. cancel-stuck cleared it.
PATCH /notes → 200 success. Re-fetched product list and confirmed outreach_notes field stored the new test note string.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 4844 lines — exceeds the recommended 700-line guideline. The Tier B refactor adds 3 helpers near line 64 but the file size remains a maintainability risk; consider splitting auth, YouTube, admin, and search into separate modules.

_yt_execute / _verify_password / _hash_password use asyncio.get_event_loop() which is deprecated for the running loop in Python 3.12+. Prefer asyncio.get_running_loop() (or asyncio.to_thread(...)) for forward compatibility. Current Python 3.11 in this env tolerates it, but production should switch to get_running_loop().

saas_radar.py /ingest and /enrich 503 guard implementation is correct and idempotent thanks to _reap_stale_jobs first. Suggestion: also include the kind ('ingest'/'enrich') in the 503 detail body so the UI can disambiguate which job is blocking.
Admin seed at server.py line 4774 intentionally uses sync pwd_context.hash — acknowledged in the review request as a one-time startup cost. Confirmed not on a request path.
